제안 논문은 temporal layer와 fine-tuning 절차를 추가해 AVEL에 맞춘 확장을 수행하지만, 기존 논문과의 직접적 공통점은 사전학습된 ImageBind 공간 활용과 Transformer 기반 구성에 있다.

differentiation_suggestions: Our work uses the pretrained ImageBind space as a component for open-vocabulary audio-visual event localization, whereas the prior work focuses on learning a general joint embedding space rather than formulating AVEL as the target task.

Our work compares audio-text and visual-text similarity consistency for event prediction in a training-free AVEL baseline, while the prior work uses cross-modal alignment to build a shared representation space instead of an explicit localization-and-classification rule.

Our work adds temporal layers implemented with standard Transformer blocks to encode within-modality temporal relations, whereas the prior work applies Transformer architectures to modality encoders without introducing an AVEL-specific temporal refinement module.
related_work_draft: The prior work (Girdhar et al., arXiv, 2023) learns a unified embedding space by aligning multiple modalities to images, enabling broad multimodal representation learning. In contrast, our work uses that pretrained space for open-vocabulary audio-visual event localization with task-specific localization, evaluation, and baseline design.

differentiation_suggestions: Our work uses the pretrained ImageBind embedding space as a component, but targets open-vocabulary audio-visual event localization with explicit category prediction for both seen and unseen events rather than general joint representation learning.

Our work leverages cross-modal similarity consistency as an inference rule for event prediction in AVEL, whereas the prior work focuses on aligning modality embeddings into a shared space rather than defining a task-specific prediction rule.

Our work applies Transformer blocks within lightweight temporal layers to model temporal relations inside audio and visual streams, while the prior work uses Transformer architectures as general modality encoders without this segment-level temporal localization objective.
related_work_draft: The prior work (Girdhar et al., arXiv, 2023) proposes ImageBind, a unified embedding space that aligns multiple modalities through image-centered representation learning. Our work builds on this shared multimodal space for open-vocabulary audio-visual event localization, while focusing on task-specific localization and categorization rather than general embedding learning.

differentiation_suggestions: Our work uses the pretrained ImageBind embedding space as a component, but targets open-vocabulary audio-visual event localization with explicit category prediction for both seen and unseen events rather than general-purpose joint embedding learning.

Our work applies the shared multimodal representation under segment-level temporal reasoning, whereas the prior work focuses on modality alignment and fixed-size embeddings without introducing a dedicated temporal layer for AVEL localization.

Our work further studies a fine-tuning procedure based on cross-entropy over seen classes for the AVEL task, while the prior work is trained with contrastive alignment objectives and is not designed around a specific downstream localization benchmark.
related_work_draft: Our work builds on the prior work by using the pretrained ImageBind joint embedding space introduced by Girdhar et al., arXiv, 2023. Unlike the prior work, which studies general multimodal representation learning, our work applies that space to open-vocabulary audio-visual event localization with task-specific temporal modeling and evaluation.
